shots.content: Inside a kitchen, a long rectangular island stands between the refrigerator wall and the sink area, with stools arranged along its sides. A woman in a navy cardigan sits on the sink-side guest stool and describes an error made during dinner preparation, while a man in a olive hoodie sits on the refrigerator-side guest stool and a woman in a burgundy sweater sits on the sink-end stool.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the refrigerator end, looking lengthwise along the kitchen island toward the sink area, with both guest-side stools and the sink-end stool in frame.

shots.content: The man in a olive hoodie asks the woman in a navy cardigan what happened next.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the cook side, centered on the two adjacent guest-side stools.

shots.content: The woman in a navy cardigan answers the man in a olive hoodie that the meal was saved.
shots.viewpoint: Top-down wide shot from directly above the kitchen island, centered on the worktop, with both guest-side stools and the sink-end stool in frame.
